messages.subject: Private Shiny Server Custom Domain
parts:
Hi all.

I was wondering whether it is possible to use custom domains for the private open source version of shiny server (https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server).  I have successfully set up a Linux virtual machine and configured a shiny server on it, but instead of accessing the shiny app with http://ip:3838/appname I'd like to be able to access it with http://customdomain/appname

Is this possible?  I see that custom domains are not yet available going with the shinyapps.io option either.

Thanks in advance!

Jeff
